title: dev-12: Test fixtures
description: Create .cook fixture files under Packages/CookbookCore/Tests/CookbookCoreTests/Fixtures/. One fixture per test scenario: empty recipe, single ingredient (no quantity), ingredient + timer with quantity, cookware, metadata block, line comment, single-line block comment, multi-line block comment (with a component inside the comment), section header, and one malformed input. Each file is named after its scenario.
acceptance_criteria: At least 10 .cook fixture files exist under Packages/CookbookCore/Tests/CookbookCoreTests/Fixtures/.
Each fixture is a valid UTF-8 text file.
Fixtures cover: empty, ingredient-no-quantity, ingredient-with-quantity, cookware, timer, metadata, line-comment, single-line-block-comment, multi-line-block-comment-with-component, section-header.
Multi-line block comment fixture contains an @ingredient between [- and -] that must NOT appear in the parsed recipe.

handoff_summary.completed: All 11 fixture files written. The multi-line block comment fixture includes `@hidden ingredient{500%g}` between `[-` and `-]` to satisfy the acceptance criterion that such a component must not appear in a parsed recipe.
handoff_summary.risks: None. These are static text fixture files with no build impact.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to write parser tests that load these fixtures and assert correct parse results.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — new files only, no existing files modified.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used canonical Cooklang syntax: `@ingredient{qty%unit}` for ingredients, `#cookware{}` for cookware, `~name{qty%unit}` for timers, `>> key: value` for metadata, `--` for line comments, `[- ... -]` for block comments, `== Name ==` for sections. The `malformed.cook` fixture exercises error-recovery scenarios (missing names, unclosed braces, missing metadata values).
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Fixtures are data-only; parser integration tests using these files are a downstream responsibility (tester bead).
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Exact parser error-recovery behaviour for `malformed.cook` depends on the parser implementation; adjust fixture if the parser strategy changes.

conflict_risks: None — new files only, no existing files modified.
